name: Orcs
startIntroPart1: Gorrash Skullsplitter, Warchief of the Orcish Horde! Our clans have been driven from the ash wastes, and now the green lands lie before us.
startIntroPart2: Raise your palisades, sharpen your axes and let the weak learn to fear the sound of our war drums.
declaringWar: Your lands will burn and your bones will decorate our halls!
attacked: You dare strike the Horde? Then you have chosen to die!
defeated: The Horde falls... but the drums will never be silent.
denounced: Our axes are thirsty, and you have just given them a reason.
introduction: I am Gorrash. Be brief, or be eaten.
hateHello: Why does your kind still breathe?
tradeRequest: The Horde offers a deal. Refuse it, and we will simply take what we want.
